beats.summary: Michael is tasked with choosing a new health care plan for the office and initially misunderstands the options.

evidence.snippet: Michael: I am going to go with the best, Jan. I am going to go with the one with the acupuncture, therapeutic massage, you know, the works.

beats.summary: Jan corrects Michael that none of the plans have acupuncture and urges him to pick the cheapest plan to save money.

evidence.snippet: Jan: Wait, acupuncture? None of the plans have acupuncture.

beats.summary: Michael delegates the task of choosing the health care plan to Jim, who declines and suggests Dwight instead.

evidence.snippet: Jim: Any time Michael asks me to do anything, I just tell him that Dwight should do it.

beats.summary: Dwight accepts the responsibility and sets up a temporary workspace in the conference room.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: Yes. I can do it. I'm your man.
Michael: You can use the conference room as a temporary workspace.

beats.summary: Dwight chooses a very harsh health care plan cutting many benefits, which upsets the employees.

evidence.snippet: Stanley: There's no dental, there's no vision, there's a $1,200 deductible.

beats.summary: Dwight justifies his harsh plan by comparing health care to survival in the wild and claims he has a perfect immune system.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: In the wild, there is no health care.
Dwight: I don't need them. Superior genes. I'm a Schrute.
